paper.title_en: Precise measurement of the thermal quenching factor of alpha particles in Li2MoO4 cryogenic calorimeters
paper.abstract_en: We present direct measurements of the thermal quenching factor (QF)for alpha-particles in Li2MoO4 scintillating crystals, conducted at base temperatures of 13 mK and 19 mK. Using gamma-calibration peaks from a 232Th source and alpha-lines from a surface 224Ra source, the QF_alpha was determined to range from 1.07 to 1.09 which is consistent with previous studies. A slight energy-dependent trend in QF_alpha was observed.
